Name: New TV channels
Author: WahrerKorsti
Description:
[u][center]NEW TV CHANNELS[/center][/u]

﻿This mod adds 3 new TV channels with over 100 new possible shows in total. 

[u][center]INTERDIMENSIONAL CABLE TV [/center][/u]
Now you can watch every Sunday one random show via the interdimensional cable TV from [i]Rick and Morty[/i]! 
Crazy shows which may gift sometimes little presents to you if you enjoy the show.

40 different shows, 12 of them will gift you small items.



[center][u]COMEDY CHANNEL[/u][/center]
Watch every tuesday the comedy channel to hear one bad joke! (Yeah, I'm sorry for how bad some of them are)
Random jokes which hopefully will make you at least smile a little bit more. :)

62 different jokes. 


[center]﻿[u]SHOPPING CHANNEL
[/u][/center][u]
[/u]Lins TV shop is being aired every thursday and sells you some items, some more other less useful. 
Every show offers only one random item. Prices are always 20% higher than the official selling price or if non available the common buying price.

25 different offers.




Still in development.




[b]Future plans coming soon (hopefully): [/b]

- Secrets of Stardew Valley-Channel
- Useless facts-channel
- song/music recommendation-channel
- Big enlargement of possible shows


More ideas or suggestions for improvement are always welcome, thanks for downloading my mod and have fun!
